notes.title: NightSong Demo 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 1.0.3

[i]- Slightly altered certain graphics and dialogue
- Reduced Van. Pyre's damage by 25 percent
- Added controls guide to inventory screen
- Engine version updated[/i]

Note : As a result of the updated engine, the volume of certain sounds was affected. I have attempted to fix this, although it's possible I've missed something. Please let me know if anything sounds abnormal. Thank you.
